name: new-energy-grid-analysis
description: 基于网上电网的新能源接入智能分析与资源优化实施项目

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w client
scripts.test: npm run test -w server && npm run test -w client
